title: Annual Accounts Act (Årsredovisningslag 1995:1554), 6 kap. Förvaltningsberättelse m.m., including the sustainability report (10 to 16 §§)
citation: Årsredovisningslag (1995:1554) 6 kap., sustainability report provisions as inserted or replaced by Lag (2024:347); consolidated text t.o.m. SFS 2026:780
evidence: Transitional provisions to Lag (2024:347) in the consolidated Act: "Denna lag träder i kraft den 1 juli 2024." The Government Offices amendment register (https://rkrattsbaser.gov.se/sfsr?bet=1995:1554) lists "Ändring, SFS 2024:347" with "Ikraft: 2024-07-01". Opened https://data.riksdagen.se/dokument/sfs-1995-1554.html and the register page on 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is the whole of 6 kap. (chapter heading to the last section, 1 § to 16 §), cut from the consolidated Act at the chapter heading; the sustainability report is 6 kap. 10 to 16 §§. Deviation from the brief: there is no "kap. 6 a"; the new sustainability rules sit in 6 kap. 12 a to 12 g, 15 and 16 §§ (the SFSR entry for Lag 2024:347 lists them as new) and in 7 kap. 31 a to 31 g (se-arl-ch7-s31). The earlier sustainability statement (6 kap. 10 to 14 §§) came in with Lag (2016:947), in force 2016-12-01 per SFSR; that and every other earlier state of the chapter is not served by any page opened, so not stored. SFSR shows no amendment to the text of 6 kap. after Lag 2024:347 (Lag 2025:1297, in force 2025-12-31, changes only points 4 and 5 of its transitional provisions, which are not in the cut), so the 2024-07-01 date is the date of the stored text. The transitional provisions at the end of the Act are not in the record. Amended by se-sfs-2024-347. Languages stored on 2026-11-02: sv. Riksdagen serves the Swedish text only; no other language version was found on any page opened. English: looked for on https://www.government.se/ (home page and /legal-documents/); both answered 403 with a Cloudflare challenge to curl and to WebFetch on 2026-11-02, so the Government Offices' translations could not be checked and no English record is stored (row SE-GOVERNMENT-TRANSLATION is permission requested).
